title: Microsoft 365 Backup: dedicated Microsoft 365 Backup Administrator role
summary: Hold: enabling email notifications alone does not deliver the promised policy-change alerts; routine events need a separate opt-in and some jobs are excluded. Group assignments also need a role-assignable group and Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2, while the stated Graph administrator-role requirement applies to delegated access, not every Graph call.
